_comment: Manu's way. Keys are flat dotted catalogue paths (SettingsJson_Path), deliberately not nested, so 'does this preset name only catalogue paths' is a one-line test. Only keys whose value differs from the shipped default appear here — a preset that restates a default is a default that can never move. The four models.* rows (supervisor, implementer, reviewer, solo) were removed by ruling on 2026-09-12 (task-6 fix round 1): the owner's own request is that Opus is the SHIPPED default, and a preset that restates an older model on every judging role makes that default unreachable in practice, satisfied on paper and nowhere else. effort.supervisor and effort.solo stay — they are the owner's working preferences, not models. phone.replyKeyboard ('on') was removed by the owner's answer to D5 on 2026-09-14 — the reply keyboard is off for both presets, so classic no longer states the key and reads the shipped 'off'. phone.aggregationSeconds and phone.finishedMessageSeconds are 6 and 6 by the owner's request of 2026-09-23 (ai-orchestrator-29 entry [9]): six seconds to press Wait under the receipt, and NO shorter wait for a message that reads as finished, because the shipped 2 s let one leave before Wait could reach it.
